title: Consolidate adopter profile documentation
description:
Adopters reach one canonical profile reference and preferred dogfood quickstart from concise entry pages, while manual hierarchy, gate, and planning-bracket setup remains discoverable as advanced customization.

## Background

The profile MVP becomes the preferred onboarding route without removing legitimate advanced configuration. Volatile package facts and guarantees have one canonical owner; audience-specific entry pages link instead of repeating them.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The quickstart demonstrates the embedded offline profile and links to a single canonical command/package/guarantee reference.
- [hard] REQ-02: README, installation, configuration, gate-preset, planning, skill, deployment, examples, and CLI references link instead of repeating volatile inventories, commands, or guarantee prose, and all links/citations resolve.
- [hard] REQ-03: The reference states transaction/recovery limits and the exact post-1.0 lifecycle exclusions without implying local packages, composition, variables, upgrade, or removal exist.
- [hard] REQ-04: `./scripts/docs-mechanical.sh README.md INSTALL.md docs .agents/skills scripts .jit/reference profiles/jit-dogfood` passes as explicit full-surface evidence in addition to the configured docs gate.

## Scope

**Blast radius:** `README.md`, `INSTALL.md`, quickstart, CLI/config/storage/guarantee/gate/planning references, relevant how-to pages/examples, skill documentation links, and generated references; one canonical fact owner replaces repetition without removing navigation.

**Green landing:** All public entry points resolve to the canonical reference, advanced manuals remain usable, and mechanical documentation checks pass without relying on future wording changes.
